runtime_downloads: Local bundled assets only; no CDN or external HTTP.
inspection: Actual ZIP listings and GLB JSON inspected; Car Kit includes sedan, truck and ambulance but no bus, motorcycle or passenger tricycle.

assets.author: Kenney
assets.modifications: Embedded original palette atlas in GLB; geometry and colors unchanged on disk.
assets.orientation: Vehicle sources face +Z. Runtime rotates +90 degrees about Y to forward +X; props retain source orientation.
assets.normalization: Runtime bakes node transforms, centers X/Z bounds, grounds minimum Y, normalizes footprint to one unit and height to class profile; instance scale uses authoritative engine length/width.

fallbacks: Every imported class and road prop has a distinct procedural fallback; errors are reported non-blockingly.
contracts: All classes use centered ground origin and forward +X; footprint follows engine dimensions. Opaque glass; cached shared geometries/materials; class/material instancing; resources disposed once per library.
